install_route: running UE editor over MCP (127.0.0.1:8000/mcp): AssetTools.duplicate (backup) -> AssetTools.delete -> StaticMeshTools.import_file (combine_meshes=true, import_materials=false) -> StaticMeshTools.set_material (that rifle's own magazine-slot material) -> AssetTools.save_assets

SM_ExtMag_M440.note: factory PMAG extended by a repeated clean band; UV0 is the factory magazine's own UV, so the part binds the rifle's magazine-slot material like AKM/QBZ

SM_ExtMag_QBZ40.note: factory 5.8 mm magazine extended by a repeated clean band; material unchanged from round 4

SM_ExtMag_AKM40.note: untouched this round: still the round-3 per-section tangent build (build_extmag_from_factory.py), whose 6 cm band is ramped in with a smoothstep, i.e. the surface inside the band is stretched rather than repeated. Not part of the duplicate-band rebuild.

backups./Game/_ExtMagSuperseded/SM_ExtMag_M440_r: the pre-round-5 M4 mesh (bounds 4.346 x 9.694 x 23.630 cm, material M_M4_ext_mag)
backups./Game/_ExtMagSuperseded/SM_ExtMag_QBZ40_: the pre-round-5 QBZ mesh (bounds 4.628 x 13.273 x 24.729 cm)

not_done: not launched in game and not judged by the user: seating, reload follow and in-game look are still user-side checks
